source_refs.note: Unit 3 opening: the book's INTRODUCTION and 3.1 Quadratic Function up to 3.1.1 (book p. 34); About this unit and all callouts marked Teaching note / Key points / Common mistake are ours.

blocks.text: Assalam-o-alaikum bachon! Aaj se hum Unit 3 shuru kar rahe hain: Theory of Quadratic Functions. Aap ne pichli classon mein quadratic equations hal ki hain, jaise \(x^{2} - 5x + 6 = 0\). Is unit mein hum ek qadam aage jayenge: ab \(x^{2}\) wala expression sirf "zero ke barabar" nahi hoga, balke ek function hoga jis ka graph banta hai, jis ki sab se oonchi ya sab se neechi value hoti hai, aur jis ka inverse bhi nikal sakta hai.

Kitab ka introduction yeh batata hai ke is unit mein kya kya hai: quadratic functions ki maximum aur minimum value completing the square aur graph ki madad se nikalna; quadratic function ka inverse aur us ka domain aur range; absolute value wali quadratic equations aur inequalities hal karna; rational, radical aur exponential shakal ki aisi equations jo quadratic equation mein badal jati hain; aur aakhir mein quadratic equations aur inequalities ke real-world istemaal, jo problem-solving ki mazboot buniyad dete hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Introduction mein "exponential" equations ka zikr bhi hai. Lekin is unit ke sections (3.4.1 aur 3.4.2) sirf rational aur radical equations parhate hain; exponential equations par is unit mein koi alag section ya example nahi hai. Is liye agar aap ko yeh hissa na mile to pareshan na hon, kitab mein yeh mojood hi nahi.

blocks.title: About this unit
blocks.text:
Yeh unit kis baare mein hai: quadratic function \(f(x) = ax^{2} + bx + c\) bohat si cheezon ko bayan karta hai. Hawa mein phenki hui gend ka raasta, kisi khet ki baar (fence) se sab se bara area, kisi factory ki sab se kam lagat (cost): in sab sawalon ke peeche yahi function hota hai. Is ka graph ek khaas mura hua curve hai jise parabola kehte hain.
Aap kya seekhenge: quadratic function ka sketch banana aur us se vertex (choti ya tah wala point), intercepts aur barhne/ghatne ke intervals parhna (3.1.1); completing the square se maximum ya minimum value nikalna (3.1.2); quadratic function ka inverse aur us ka domain aur range (3.2); absolute value wali quadratic equations aur inequalities (3.3); rational aur radical equations jo quadratic ban jati hain (3.4); aur real-world problems (3.5).
Pehle se kya aana chahiye: quadratic equation ko factorization aur quadratic formula \(x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^{2}-4ac}}{2a}\) se hal karna; coordinate plane par points lagana; Unit 2 se domain, range, one-to-one aur inverse function ka matlab; aur interval notation jaise \([2, \infty)\) aur \((-1, 7)\). Agar in mein se kuch kamzor hai to pehle dohra lijiye, yeh har page par kaam aayega.
Ab pehli definition dhyan se parhiye. Quadratic function ek aisa polynomial function hai jis ki degree do (2) ho. Aam tor par ise standard form (mayaari shakal) mein yun likhte hain:

blocks.text_alt: f of x equals a x squared plus b x plus c

blocks.text: jahan \(a\), \(b\) aur \(c\) real numbers hain, aur \(a \ne 0\). Yani \(a\) kabhi zero nahi ho sakta.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
"Degree do" ka matlab hai ke \(x\) ki sab se bari power 2 hai. In teen numbers ke apne naam hain, aur yeh naam poori unit mein baar baar aayenge:
\(a\) ko leading coefficient kehte hain (yani woh number jo \(x^{2}\) ke saath laga hai),
\(b\) coefficient of \(x\) hai (jo \(x\) ke saath laga hai),
\(c\) constant term hai (akela number, jis ke saath koi \(x\) nahi).
\(a \ne 0\) kyun? Kyun ke agar \(a = 0\) ho jaye to \(x^{2}\) wala term ghayab ho jata hai aur \(f(x) = bx + c\) bach jata hai, jo ek linear function (seedhi lakeer) hai, quadratic nahi. Yani quadratic hone ki shart hi yeh hai ke \(x^{2}\) mojood rahe. Haan, \(b\) aur \(c\) zero ho sakte hain; is se function quadratic hi rehta hai.

blocks.caption: Reading a, b and c (our examples; the sign goes with the number)

blocks.text: Is table ko ghor se dekhiye. Har number apne sign ke saath jata hai: \(-x^{2}\) mein \(x^{2}\) ke saath chhupa hua \(-1\) hai, is liye \(a = -1\). Doosri line mein \(x\) wala term hai hi nahi, is liye \(b = 0\). Aur aakhri line mein na \(x\) wala term hai na akela number, is liye \(b = 0\) aur \(c = 0\); phir bhi yeh quadratic hai kyun ke \(a = 3 \ne 0\).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Coefficients parhne se pehle hamesha function ko \(ax^{2} + bx + c\) ki tarteeb (order) mein likh lijiye. Misaal: \(f(x) = 6 - x - x^{2}\) ko tarteeb se likhein to \(-x^{2} - x + 6\) banta hai. Ab saaf nazar aata hai ke \(a = -1\), \(b = -1\), \(c = 6\). Agar tarteeb ke baghair parhein to bohat se students ghalti se \(a = 6\) likh dete hain, aur phir poora sawal ghalat ho jata hai.
\(a\) ka sign sab se ahem maloomat hai. Agle page (3.1.1) mein aap dekhenge ke yahi sign faisla karta hai ke graph upar ki taraf khulega ya neeche ki taraf, aur function ki minimum value hogi ya maximum.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
\(f(x) = 5 - 2x^{2}\) mein \(a\), \(b\), \(c\) kya hain? Pehle tarteeb se likhiye, phir jawab dekhiye.
Jawab: \(f(x) = -2x^{2} + 0x + 5\), is liye \(a = -2\), \(b = 0\), \(c = 5\). Aur kya \(g(x) = (x + 1)^{2} - x^{2}\) quadratic hai? Khol kar dekhiye: \(x^{2} + 2x + 1 - x^{2} = 2x + 1\). Yahan \(x^{2}\) khatam ho gaya, is liye yeh linear hai, quadratic nahi.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text: Yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ka sawal nahi. Aik gend ko upar phenka jaye to us ki oonchai (meter mein) waqt \(t\) (second mein) ke saath taqreeban \(h(t) = -5t^{2} + 20t + 1\) ho sakti hai. Yeh quadratic function hai: \(a = -5\), \(b = 20\), \(c = 1\). Yahan \(c = 1\) ka matlab hai ke shuru mein (\(t = 0\) par) gend zameen se 1 meter upar thi, kyun ke \(h(0) = 1\). Aur \(a = -5\) negative hai; agle page par aap seekhenge ke is ka matlab hai ke graph neeche ki taraf khulta hai, yani gend ek had tak upar ja kar wapas aati hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Quadratic function ki standard form \(f(x) = ax^{2} + bx + c\) hai; \(a, b, c\) real numbers hain aur \(a \ne 0\).
2. Is ki degree 2 hai: \(x\) ki sab se bari power 2.
3. \(a\) leading coefficient, \(b\) coefficient of \(x\), \(c\) constant term.
4. Coefficients parhne se pehle terms ko \(x^{2}\), \(x\), constant ki tarteeb mein likhein.
5. \(b\) aur \(c\) zero ho sakte hain, \(a\) nahi.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Sign chhor dena: \(f(x) = -x^{2} - 2x + 3\) mein \(a = -1\) aur \(b = -2\) hain, \(1\) aur \(2\) nahi. Bachne ka tareeqa: har term ko us ke sign samait ghera (circle) laga kar parhein.
2. Be-tarteeb expression se coefficients parhna: \(6 - x - x^{2}\) mein \(a\) 6 nahi, \(-1\) hai.
3. \(a = 0\) wale function ko quadratic kehna: \(0x^{2} + 5x + 1\) asal mein \(5x + 1\) hai, jo linear hai.
4. Brackets khole baghair faisla karna: \((x+1)^{2} - x^{2}\) dekhne mein quadratic lagta hai magar khol kar linear nikalta hai.
